# MergeTree engine

## Parts

A part is an immutable set of files on disk holding a sorted range of rows. Parts are never modified in place; a merge replaces several parts

modified in place; a merge replaces several parts with one.

# Ingestion pipeline

## Batches

Inserts are buffered into blocks before they are written. A block has a maximum size controlled by min_insert_block_size_rows and min_insert_block_size_bytes.
